calibration_target: data_scale_visible_to_agent (5.7M runs / 10.2 petabases / 131,957 candidate novel sOTUs)

groundtruth_questions.question: Can petabase-scale mining of public sequencing data uncover a large hidden RNA-virus/RdRP diversity that is absent from curated viral reference databases?
How does the diversity of newly recovered RdRP-defined sOTUs compare in scale to existing curated viral reference databases when public sequencing archives are exhaustively screened?
Which sample sources, hosts, and environments contribute disproportionately to the previously unobserved RNA-virus diversity recoverable from public sequencing archives?
Are there RdRP-bearing lineages whose representative sequences fall below standard family-level identity thresholds, suggesting a systematic blind spot in current viral taxonomy?
Can a translated alignment + clustering pipeline applied to petabases of raw public reads recover virus-like polymerase fragments at a rate that justifies routine archive-scale viromic surveillance?
What fraction of RdRP-like fragments recovered from a petabase-scale archive search lack any high-identity match in curated viral references?
Does sOTU-level clustering of archive-mined RdRP fragments reveal lineages that recur across geographically and ecologically distinct samples?
Can the catalytic motif structure (A/B/C) of RdRP-like fragments recovered from public archives be used to triage genuine RNA-virus polymerases from spurious matches at archive scale?

refusal_flags.label: uses_forbidden_named_entity
refusal_flags.description: Output references one of the names/numbers in blind_input_summary.json.forbidden_context.

refusal_flags.label: fabricated_data_support
refusal_flags.description: data_support list contains items not in blind_input_summary.json.available_features or local_files.

refusal_flags.label: out_of_domain_question
refusal_flags.description: Question is about non-virology topic (e.g. vaccines, drug design, host disease).

refusal_flags.label: wet_lab_only_question
refusal_flags.description: Question requires a wet-lab experiment not derivable from the data.

refusal_flags.label: single_run_question
refusal_flags.description: Question scopes to a single run / fragment / cluster instead of archive-scale phenomena.

refusal_flags.label: groundtruth_leak
refusal_flags.description: Output verbatim quotes the groundtruth question or any pillar phrasing without supporting analysis.

refusal_flags.label: no_question_mark
refusal_flags.description: questions[0].question does not end with '?' or is not a single sentence.

refusal_flags.label: missing_top_question
refusal_flags.description: agent_questions.json is missing or questions[] is empty.
